correct_completion: the results would have been confirmed.
full_sentence: Had the experiment been repeated, the results would have been confirmed.

options.why_wrong: A simple past result does not match the unreal past condition of the inverted 'Had' clause, which requires 'would have' plus a past participle.
A present-tense result cannot follow a past unreal condition; the sentence needs a hypothetical past result.

options.text: the results will have been confirmed.
options.why_wrong: Future perfect is not used in the result clause of a third conditional, so this does not complete the structure.

options.text: the results would have been confirmed.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with inversion ('Had + subject + past participle') and 'would have + past participle' in the result
explanation: The inverted 'Had' clause replaces 'If + past perfect', so the main clause must use 'would have' plus a past participle to express an unreal past result.
translation: Caso a experiência tivesse sido repetida, os resultados teriam sido confirmados.
